how_to_apply: Visit the official bank website at www.mucb.bank.in between 16 October 2026 and 31 October 2026.
Fill out the online application form completely and correctly with all required details.
Download and print a copy of the submitted online application.

content_sections.heading: Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank Clerical Trainee Quick Facts

rows.details: The Mehsana Urban Co-op. Bank Ltd., Mehsana
Rs. 22,000 per month for the first two years
Two years fixed pay, followed by clerical scale pay
Candidates with UGC recognized Gujarat University degree meeting eligibility criteria

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides a total of approximately 35 vacancies for the Clerical Trainee position. These vacancies are to be filled for the remote branches of the bank excluding Mehsana district branches.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a degree from a UGC-recognized Gujarat university under one of the following criteria: MCom., MSc. (Science), MCA, MBA (Graduation or Post-Graduation in both must have at least 55% marks). MSc. (Science), MCA, MBA in direct course with at least 55% marks. Knowledge of Gujarati language is compulsory. Applicants must be between 21 years and 30 years of age as on 1 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 22,000/- for the first two years. Thereafter, they will be paid according to the regular clerical scale.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank Clerical Trainee
content_sections.text: Visit the official bank website at www.mucb.bank.in between 16 October 2026 and 31 October 2026. Fill out the online application form completely and correctly with all required details. Submit the online application form. Download and print a copy of the submitted online application. Prepare a non-refundable Demand Draft (DD) of Rs. 100/- in favour of "The Mehsana Urban Co-op. Bank Ltd." Attach the Demand Draft to the printed copy of the online application. Send the application print copy along with the DD via Registered Post or Courier to the bank's head office address so that it reaches by 5 November 2026. Head Office Address: The Mehsana Urban Co-op. Bank Ltd. Corporate Building, Highway, Mehsana - 384002

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of an online written test conducted by IBPS Mumbai, followed by an oral interview for qualified candidates. Candidates who have passed Post Graduation at the time of the personal interview will be considered eligible.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced for Clerical Trainee?
faq.answer: There are approximately 35 vacancies announced for the Clerical Trainee post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to send the printed application by post?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the online application along with the DD must reach the bank by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MCom, MSc (Science), MCA, or MBA degree with at least 55% marks from a UGC-recognized Gujarat university, along with knowledge of the Gujarati language.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years of age as on 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Applicants must pay a non-refundable Demand Draft of Rs. 100/- in favour of The Mehsana Urban Co-op. Bank Ltd.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or stipend during the training period?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 22,000/- for the first two years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an online written examination conducted by IBPS Mumbai followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The vacancies are to be filled for the remote branches of Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank excluding branches located within the Mehsana district.
